limitations: No claim about maximum cograph refinement rounds at orders greater than eleven, no general asymptotic bound, and no exhaustive historical-priority certificate. The exact finite threshold is a canonical-cotree exhaustive proof supplemented by a direct witness calculation.
scientific_scope: Finite simple uncolored undirected P4-free graphs; C^2 one-free-variable types and simultaneous color refinement; precise threshold four versus three strict rounds, through order eleven.
title: Sharp order-eleven four-round threshold in two-variable counting logic on cographs
